activeKey.zh-CN: 当前展开面板的 key，可用 `bind:activeKey` 双向绑定；null 与空字符串表示全部收起。函数绑定 `bind:activeKey={get, set}` 时完全受控；只传 `activeKey` 时作为初值，点击在组件内覆盖。
activeKey.en-US: Key of the currently expanded panel; bind it with `bind:activeKey`. null and the empty string mean all panels are collapsed. `bind:activeKey={get, set}` makes it fully controlled; a plain `activeKey` is the initial value and a click overrides it inside the component.

clickHeaderToExpand.zh-CN: 点击面板头整行展开收起；为 false 时只响应切换按钮和箭头。
clickHeaderToExpand.en-US: Clicking anywhere in the header row toggles the panel; when false only the toggle button and the arrow respond.

collapseIcon.zh-CN: 面板展开时显示的图标的 snippet，默认 IconChevronUp。
collapseIcon.en-US: Snippet for the icon shown while a panel is expanded, IconChevronUp by default.

expandIcon.zh-CN: 面板收起时显示的图标的 snippet，默认 IconChevronDown。
expandIcon.en-US: Snippet for the icon shown while a panel is collapsed, IconChevronDown by default.

expandIconPosition.zh-CN: 展开图标位置，可选 left、right。
expandIconPosition.en-US: Position of the expand icon: left or right.

keepDOM.zh-CN: 是否保留隐藏面板的 DOM 树，默认销毁；未传时依次读 Collapse、Collapsible 的全局默认值。
keepDOM.en-US: Whether to keep the DOM tree of hidden panels; destroyed by default. When omitted it reads the global default of Collapse, then that of Collapsible.

lazyRender.zh-CN: 配合 keepDOM 使用，为 true 时面板展开前不渲染内容。
lazyRender.en-US: Used with keepDOM; when true, panel content is not rendered until the panel is first expanded.

motion.zh-CN: 是否开启动画，默认开启；未传时依次读 Collapse、Collapsible 的全局默认值。
motion.en-US: Whether to enable the animation; enabled by default. When omitted it reads the global default of Collapse, then that of Collapsible.

onChange.zh-CN: 切换面板时调用，参数为展开面板的 key 数组与原生 MouseEvent（键盘操作经原生按钮同样是 click）。
onChange.en-US: Called when a panel is toggled, with the array of expanded keys and the native MouseEvent (keyboard use also produces a click through the native button).

children.zh-CN: 面板内容的 snippet；传入 children 才算有内容。
children.en-US: Snippet for the panel content; a panel counts as having content only when children is given.

extra.zh-CN: 面板头右侧辅助内容的 snippet，位于切换按钮之外，可以放控件。
extra.en-US: Snippet for the auxiliary content on the right of the panel header, outside the toggle button; may hold controls.

header.zh-CN: 面板头内容的 snippet，渲染在切换按钮内，不能包含交互元素。
header.en-US: Snippet for the panel header content, rendered inside the toggle button; must not contain interactive elements.

itemKey.zh-CN: 必填且唯一，用于匹配 activeKey。
itemKey.en-US: Required and unique, matched against activeKey.

onMotionEnd.zh-CN: 展开或收起动画结束时调用。
onMotionEnd.en-US: Called when the expand or collapse animation ends.

showArrow.en-US: Whether to show the arrow icon.
